blindSummary: This state/province passed one of the country's fullest sub-national rights statutes: a recognition-and-rights law (2025) alongside a 2024 penal-code alignment with transfeminicide provisions. The country's top court struck down the statute's adults-only limitation in 2026, extending its reach to minors - confirming both the unit's protective-law ambition and the judiciary's role in completing it. No dedicated incident or enforcement reporting was found for this unit beyond these statutes, which is itself notable given the violence levels documented nationally; the protective framework is legislative rather than documented in practice.
